page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words were copied from the scan with low certainty because the print is small and blurred. Hebrew fragments marked here were not read letter by letter: שפה ברורה, ירוד מורא, צחות, מדקדקי לשון הקדש, שת ירות, יד חעני ניד המלך, and אור שהוא חגדה התורה. Their vowel points and exact letters should be checked against the original. Printed "8." after "digitos" and the form "Libros." are kept as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
